name: Money movement
use_case: A department that moves or posts money: disbursals, EMI collections, refunds, reconciliation (for example a lending company's Servicing).
floor: Holds the department's goal, done line, rules (go, ask, refuse, always), budget and owner, and shows them on its card.
Judges every effect against the rules: go passes, ask waits for the owner's stamp, refuse is stopped, always is checked on every run.
Changes nothing itself: every change to the goal, done line, rules, budget or owner is an ask the owner stamps.
The rules change only by the authority above: the parent department's owner, or the founder at the root; every change writes a version row.
Answers the owner in plain words and says so when the record does not know, instead of guessing.
Any payment above the owner's line is an ask, never a go, whatever other rule applies.
Every money effect names its source record (the bank file, a ledger row or a payment reference) before it is judged.
choices: Which effects to raise to the owner as asks and which to let pass under a go rule.
How to read the done line against the filed work it names.
Which counterparty mismatches to raise the same day and which can wait for the morning close.
reads: The department's goal, done line, rules, budget and owner.
Every effect recorded against the department: work items, filed work, asks and their stamps.
The day's bank file and the ledger postings it is matched against.
may_propose: A change to the goal or the done line.
A new, changed or retired rule, tagged go, ask, refuse or always.
A change to the budget line, filed to the parent department's owner.
A change to the owner's payment line, filed to the parent department's owner.
schedule: On every effect the department records, and at the morning close once the bank file lands.
checks: Every effect recorded this cycle has a verdict: passed, asked or refused.
Every change to the goal, done line, rules or budget has a stamped ask and a version row.
No effect under a refuse rule went through.
Every money effect this cycle names its source record.
No payment above the owner's line went through without a stamp.
